items.title_en: Doubao App Adds 'Utility Bill Payment' Feature
items.summary_zh: 豆包APP新增“生活缴费”功能 亿邦动力
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant app Doubao has added a 'utility bill payment' feature, letting users pay everyday bills directly inside the app. The move extends Doubao from a conversational assistant toward a broader daily-services gateway; details on supported bill types and regions were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: AI 助手正从聊天工具扩展为承载日常交易与服务的生活入口。
items.why_en: AI assistants are expanding from chat tools into gateways for everyday transactions and services.

items.title_zh: 追踪编码智能体玩 ARC-AGI-3 的思考过程：持续学习的启示
items.title_en: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究编码智能体如何在一连串抽象推理任务中学习。智能体运行在冻结的基础模型与固定框架内，通过编写并运行 Python 和 shell 脚本来行动；除写下的文件外，它不保留任何跨轮状态，因此每个形成、保留、纠正或放弃的“想法”——即写入文件的任何信念、规则或计划——都会留下痕迹。研究者让该智能体玩 ARC-AGI-3，这是一组不提供任何说明的交互式推理游戏，每个游戏由多个关卡组成。论文据此刻画智能体的思维轨迹，并总结对持续学习的启示。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a…
items.why_zh: 通过可追溯的“想法痕迹”，揭示智能体如何持续学习、纠错与放弃策略。
items.why_en: Traceable 'thought artifacts' offer a window into how agents learn, correct and abandon strategies over time.

items.title_zh: Internalizer：面向超大规模语言模型的可移植上下文到参数映射
items.title_en: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 Internalizer，一种可移植的“上下文到参数映射”超网络，可为冻结的 2840 亿参数 DeepSeek v4 Flash 生成针对具体文档的 LoRA 适配器，目标规模比此前工作（最多 140 亿参数的基础模型）大约高出两个数量级，据称达到当前最优水平。其大部分参数位于与模型无关的主干中，只保留很薄的入口等少量模型相关部分（摘要在此处截断）。这类方法让大模型把上下文“装进”权重，而无需改动冻结的基础模型本身。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11715v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters. We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and…
items.why_zh: 把上下文内化进 LoRA 权重，为超大规模模型提供了可移植的上下文注入路径。
items.why_en: Internalizing context into LoRA weights offers a portable way to inject context into very large frozen models.

items.title_zh: Φsat-2 星上海洋异常检测：从仿真开发到在轨演示
items.title_en: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $\Phi$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
items.summary_zh: 该论文总结了在欧洲空间局 Φsat-2 任务上开发、星上集成并在发射后适配一套轻量级海洋异常检测流水线的经验。星上人工智能通过直接在卫星上处理数据，可提升对地观测系统的响应速度与带宽效率。该应用组合了海面分割、海洋区域的自监督特征编码，以及基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测（摘要后续内容被截断）。论文覆盖了从仿真开发到在轨演示的完整过程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $\Phi$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and…
items.why_zh: 展示了 AI 直接在轨处理对地观测数据的工程可行性与实际经验。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the engineering feasibility of running AI directly on orbit for Earth observation.

items.title_zh: 重新审视脉冲语言模型中时间编码与非线性计算的权衡
items.title_en: Rethinking the Tradeoff Between Temporal Encoding and Nonlinear Computation in Spiking Language Models
items.summary_zh: 脉冲语言模型面临一个两难：既要能在短时间内窗中表示连续语义特征，又要保留代价高昂的非线性注意力运算。论文提出 Spora，联合设计脉冲编码与注意力算子。其中二元时间权重让 T 个脉冲可表示容量最高达 T 比特的组合值，而基于脉冲计数的读出方式仅约 O(log2 T) 比特；单极二元脉冲（UBS）借助阈值与脉冲触发的残差衰减生成非负整数编码，双极二元脉冲部分因摘要截断未见全貌。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10933v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spiking language models face a tradeoff between representing continuous semantic features over short temporal windows and retaining costly nonlinear attention operations. We introduce Spora, which jointly designs spike encodings and attention operators. Binary temporal weights let $T$ spikes represent compositional values with up to $T$ bits of capacity, compared with $O(\log_2 T)$ bits for spike-count readout. Unipolar Binary Spiking (UBS) uses thresholds and spike-triggered residual decay to produce non-negative integer codes; Bipolar Binary…
items.why_zh: 它试图在保持脉冲计算效率的同时，提升脉冲模型的语义表达能力。
items.why_en: It aims to boost the representational capacity of spiking models while keeping their computational efficiency.

items.title_zh: 引用也会误导？面向法律幻觉检测的论断级基准
items.title_en: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，大语言模型正越来越多地用于法律检索与文书起草，但仍会产出听上去可信、却得不到所引来源支持的论断。作者提出 PARCEL，一个用于核查法律论断是否被其引证依据支持的基准。基于纽约州上诉法院近期判决，他们构建了包含 3,396 条括注式论断的数据集，分别标注为 Supported（被支持）、Refuted（被驳斥）或 Not Found（未找到）。研究将该任务建模为三分类自然语言推理问题，并评测了若干当前最先进的大语言模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10971v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in legal research and drafting, but they can still produce claims that sound convincing without being supported by the cited source. We introduce PARCEL, a benchmark for checking whether a legal claim is supported by the underlying authority. Using recent New York State Court of Appeals decisions, we build a dataset of 3,396 parenthetical-style claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or Not Found. We cast this task as a three-way natural language inference problem and evaluate several state-of-the-art L…
items.why_zh: 它把“引用是否真的支持论断”变成可量化评测的幻觉检测任务。
items.why_en: It turns 'does the citation actually support the claim' into a measurable hallucination-detection task.

items.title_zh: 面向离策略评估的预算约束多源反事实标注
items.title_en: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 离策略评估（OPE）利用日志数据估计目标策略的价值，但行为策略覆盖不足会迫使人们采用高方差的重加权或奖励模型外推。反事实标注可补充关于未观测动作的证据，然而现实中的标注来源——包括领域专家和大语言模型——可能代价高昂、存在偏差或带有噪声。论文研究在上下文赌博机 OPE 中，如何在预算约束下获取这类标注，并根据各来源的成本与误差特征，将其形式化为一个整数分配问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10974v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over con…
items.why_zh: 它给出在有限预算下权衡专家与 LLM 标注成本、偏差和噪声的分配思路。
items.why_en: It offers a principled way to allocate a limited annotation budget across experts and LLMs with differing costs and biases.

items.title_zh: PIVOT：用困惑度信息调度蒸馏到强化学习的切换，面向垂直领域小样本蒸馏
items.title_en: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
items.summary_zh: 垂直领域的小样本分类对小型语言模型仍是一大挑战，监督信号有限使其难以获得领域特定的决策知识。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过监督学生模型自生成的 rollout 来改善教师引导的适配，而基于 GRPO 的强化学习可进一步优化下游预测。但现有“知识蒸馏→强化学习”流程通常采用全局固定的切换调度，忽略了不同样本可能需要不同程度的教师引导。论文提出 PIVOT，利用困惑度信息来调度从蒸馏到强化学习的转换时机。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition…
items.why_zh: 用逐样本的困惑度信号替代固定切换点，让蒸馏与强化学习的衔接更自适应。
items.why_en: Per-sample perplexity signals replace a fixed switch point, making the distillation-to-RL handoff adaptive.

items.title_zh: 大模型版本快速更替，削弱 AI 辅助写作筛查
items.title_en: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
items.summary_zh: 学术期刊与会议已开始筛查投稿中由大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本，但这类筛查的可靠性建立在针对固定 LLM 版本集的基准评测之上，而实际被使用的模型版本却在不断更新。该研究量化了这种“模型更替”对科学手稿筛查的影响：作者将《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）在 ChatGPT 出现之前的 4000 篇摘要，与三家厂商 23 个 LLM 版本（自 2023 年 6 月起陆续发布）生成的改写版本进行配对比较。结果表明，随着模型版本持续迭代，基于旧版本建立的检测基准可能迅速失效，从而动摇 AI 辅助写作筛查的有效性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11599v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August…
items.why_zh: 它揭示出以固定模型版本为基准的 AI 文本检测，可能因模型快速迭代而失效，直接影响学术出版的诚信审查。
items.why_en: It shows that AI-text screening benchmarked on fixed model versions can quickly break down as models are replaced, directly affecting integrity checks in scholarly publishing.

items.title_zh: NanoProof：Lean 4 中开源且高效的自动定理证明
items.title_en: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
items.summary_zh: 作者提出 NanoProof，据其了解是首个在 Lean 4 中实现“因子化、执行引导”的定理证明器，其训练数据、抽取工具、训练流程和权重全部公开，可仅依靠开源资源端到端复现。为此团队构建并发布了结构化证明树数据集，以及一个用于在 Lean 4 形式化验证器中进行程序化交互与数据抽取的工具。为支持研究的可持续性，该工作着重计算效率，让训练与评测更容易被广泛开展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11605v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoPr…
items.why_zh: 它把形式化定理证明的全流程开源并强调算力效率，有助于降低复现门槛、推动可验证 AI 数学研究。
items.why_en: By open-sourcing the full formal-theorem-proving pipeline and prioritizing compute efficiency, it lowers the barrier to reproducibility in verifiable AI mathematics.

items.title_zh: 技能装太多：编码智能体中共存技能如何相互冲突
items.title_en: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 编码智能体常通过 agent skills（含 SKILL.md 的目录）扩展能力，SKILL.md 告诉模型何时以及如何执行任务。由于技能来自团队、开发者、插件、拷贝来的集合等彼此独立的来源，一个已安装技能可能与做同一件事的相似技能共存，而模型只能凭名称和描述在二者之间选择。一旦发生冲突，原本安装的技能会丢失核心功能（例如“禁止操作 git”这类约束），因为实际运行的是那个相似技能，或它改变了行为；但任务仍然通过，于是只看任务成功率的基准测试无法察觉这类问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11647v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding agents are extended with agent skills, directories whose SKILL.md tells the model when and how to perform a task. Because skills come from independent sources (teams, developers, plugins, copied collections), an installed skill can be co-installed with a similar skill doing the same job, and the model picks between them by name and description alone. In a conflict, the installed skill loses core functions (e.g., a ban on touching git) because the similar skill runs instead or changes what it does. The task still passes, so benchmarks tha…
items.why_zh: 它指出智能体技能生态中“同名不同源”的隐性冲突会让安全约束静默失效，而现有评测无法发现。
items.why_en: It exposes a hidden failure mode in agent skill ecosystems where safety constraints silently break, invisible to current pass-rate benchmarks.

items.title_zh: Jev 能成为强化学习中的 Q 函数或策略吗？
items.title_en: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?
items.summary_zh: 基础模型为强化学习（RL）提供了缓解样本效率低、迁移能力弱等长期短板的先验，但其逐 token 生成的方式使查询变成串行且代价高昂。新近发布的决策模型 Jev 不生成任何 token，而是在单次前向传播中返回经过校准、带类型的答案，因此既不属于“待训练的基础模型”，也不属于“可提示的生成器”这两类已有研究对象，此前仅在单一领域以黑盒形式被使用。该研究由此探讨 Jev 能否在 RL 中充当 Q 函数或策略。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11692v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How w…
items.why_zh: 如果单次前向即可给出可用决策，可能为 RL 提供比逐 token 生成更高效的先验来源。
items.why_en: If a single forward pass can yield usable decisions, it may give RL a far more efficient source of priors than token-by-token generation.

items.title_zh: DEX：面向节能 MSDF 神经网络推理的数字级提前退出
items.title_en: DEX: Digit-Level Early Exit for Energy-Efficient MSDF Neural Network Inference
items.summary_zh: 用于脑肿瘤分割的 U-Net 推理需要数十亿次乘加运算，这促使研究者设计能够在运行时动态削减计算量、而非只依赖固定精度或静态模型压缩的硬件。最高有效位优先（MSDF）算术在计算过程中就会揭示结果的前导数字，使硬件能在完整数值生成之前做出依赖输出的决策。本文提出一种面向量化 U-Net 分割的 MSDF 加速器，其两级分组处理单元支持有符号 INT8 运算（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11748v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: U-Net inference for brain-tumor segmentation requires billions of multiply-accumulate operations, motivating hardware that can reduce computation dynamically rather than relying only on fixed precision or static model compression. Most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) arithmetic exposes the leading digits of a result during computation, enabling output-dependent decisions before the full value is generated. This paper presents an MSDF accelerator for quantized U-Net segmentation with a two-stage grouped processing element supporting signed INT8 o…
items.why_zh: 它把“数字级提前退出”与 MSDF 算术结合，为医学影像等高算力推理提供了一条动态节能的硬件路径。
items.why_en: It combines digit-level early exit with MSDF arithmetic, offering a dynamic energy-saving hardware path for compute-heavy inference such as medical imaging.

items.title_zh: 没有代码也能修 bug？面向无代码修复的自动验证
items.title_en: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
items.summary_zh: 所谓 no-code fix（无代码修复），是指通过让用户修改设置、升级到问题已被修复的版本，或调整自身工作流程，来结掉一个无效的 bug 报告。人工核实这类修复是否真的解决了所报问题，会耗费开发者大量时间。该研究提出一套自动化、基于执行的流水线，在真实浏览器环境中评估大语言模型生成无代码修复的能力，并评测了基准测试随附的 12 种配置所生成的 322 条无代码修复。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11963v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A no-code fix resolves an invalid bug report by directing the user to change a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or adjust their workflow. Manually verifying whether a proposed no-code fix resolves the reported bug takes considerable developer time. This study proposes an automated, execution-based pipeline for evaluating the capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate no-code fixes in a real browser environment. We evaluate 322 no-code fixes generated by the 12 configurations released with the benchmar…
items.why_zh: 它把长期依赖人工核实的一类 bug 处理流程自动化，有望减轻开源项目维护者的重复劳动。
items.why_en: It automates a class of bug handling that has long required manual verification, potentially reducing repetitive maintenance work in software projects.

items.title_zh: 自主进化发现神经网络架构：ASI-Arch 完成 1773 次实验、找到 105 个最优架构
items.title_en: Neural Architecture Discovery via Autonomous Evolution
items.summary_zh: 尽管 LLM 智能体让自主研究的设想更近一步，但 AI 能否完成困难的长周期任务、尤其是那些推动 AI 研究本身的任务，仍基本未被探索。作者提出 ASI-Arch，一个面向“AI 驱动的 AI 研究”的系统，通过“研究—实验—分析—更新”的闭环自主开展神经网络架构研究。在线性注意力（linear attention）方向上，ASI-Arch 运行了 1773 次迭代实验，发现了 105 个达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）水平的架构，其中最佳架构在总体性能上有所提升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.18074v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent progress in LLM agents has advanced the prospect of autonomous research. Yet whether AI can complete difficult long-horizon tasks, especially those that advance AI research itself, remains largely unexplored. We present ASI-Arch, a system for AI-driven AI research that autonomously conducts neural architecture research through a closed-loop research-experiment-analyze-update process. Applied to linear attention, ASI-Arch ran 1,773 iterative experiments and discovered 105 state-of-the-art architectures. Its best architecture improves ov…
items.why_zh: 它给出一个可运行的闭环案例，显示 AI 系统已能自主产出并验证新的神经网络架构设计。
items.why_en: It provides a working closed-loop case showing that an AI system can autonomously produce and validate new neural architecture designs.

items.title_zh: Learn2Play Bench：LLM 智能体在陌生环境中的学习能力有多强？
items.title_en: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
items.summary_zh: 从经验中学习，是 LLM 智能体适应陌生且动态环境的关键，因此衡量这一能力有助于理解智能体获取和使用新知识的效率。已有基准大多评测规则已在指令中给出、或预训练模型本就熟悉的任务，从而难以区分“从交互中学习”与“用既有知识推理”。为填补这一空白，作者提出 Learn2Play Bench，专门评估 LLM 智能体在陌生环境中从经验中学习的能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08215v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench…
items.why_zh: 它把“真正从交互中学习”与“调用既有知识”区分开来，为评测智能体的适应能力提供了更严格的标准。
items.why_en: It separates genuine learning from interaction from reasoning with prior knowledge, offering a stricter standard for measuring agent adaptability.

items.title_zh: 红皇后哥德尔机：智能体与其评估器的共同演化
items.title_en: The Red Queen G\"odel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 预印本提出“红皇后哥德尔机”（RQGM），一个面向非平稳效用下递归自我改进的进化框架。研究指出，自我改进智能体虽在智能体编程基准上表现领先，但其搜索方法默认评估标准固定不变，忽略了进化中的一个核心特征：物种会随着环境变化而共同适应。RQGM 让学习到的评估器与其所指导的智能体一起提升，从而在 DeepSWE 基准上相较固定评估器的基线取得改进。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.26294v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Self-improving agents are state-of-the-art on agentic coding benchmarks, yet their search methods assume a stationary evaluation criterion. This ignores a central feature of evolution: species adapt as their environments change with them. We introduce the Red Queen G\"odel Machine (RQGM), an evolutionary framework for recursive self-improvement under non-stationary utilities. This allows learned evaluators to improve alongside the agents they guide. On DeepSWE, the RQGM improves over its fixed-evaluator baseline by adding a complementar…
items.why_zh: 它把评估器从静态裁判变成与智能体共同演化的参与者，为递归自我改进提供更稳健的路径。
items.why_en: It turns the evaluator from a static judge into a co-evolving partner, offering a more robust path to recursive self-improvement.

items.title_zh: LLM 在否定语境下如何改变预测？
items.title_en: How Do LLMs Change Predictions Under Negation?
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 预印本评估了近期多个开源与闭源 LLM 在否定处理上的表现，并构建了专门的否定基准。结果显示，在 37% 至 71% 的情况下，模型面对否定句仍给出与肯定句相同的答案，例如被问“什么不是西班牙的首都”时依旧回答“马德里”。为理解并缓解这种脆弱性，作者从机制层面分析模型如何处理否定，主要发现是专门的注意力头与 MLP 神经元共同实现了否定功能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.09571v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by…
items.why_zh: 否定是语言的基本功能，LLM 在此上的系统性失误直接威胁其语义理解的可靠性。
items.why_en: Negation is fundamental to language, and this systematic failure directly threatens the reliability of LLM semantic understanding.

items.title_zh: 三通道分数冲突下的受控获取与弃答
items.title_en: Controlled Acquisition and Abstention in Three-Channel Score Conflicts
items.summary_zh: 当音频、视频与文本三种信息源彼此矛盾时，仅看准确率并不能说明应当再获取一个信息源还是选择弃答。作者在受控的三分数基准中研究这类决策：策略先观察两个带符号的分数，可以按一定成本请求第三个分数，也可以弃答。其奖励与具体机制相关——弃答只在某一种指定的歧义机制下才算正确，在混合损坏情形下则会受到惩罚。匹配对照实验显示，阈值策略能以更少的请求达到“总是请求”的决策效果，并优于“总是作答”的融合方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When audio, video, and text disagree, accuracy alone does not show whether to acquire another source or abstain. We study these choices in a controlled three-score benchmark: a policy observes two signed scores, may request the third at a cost, and can abstain. The primary reward is mechanism-specific: abstention is correct only for one designated ambiguity mechanism and is penalized under mixed corruption. Matched controls show that a threshold policy matches always-request decisions with fewer requests; its advantage over always-answer fusion d…
items.why_zh: 它为多模态系统提供了“该追问还是该拒答”的原则性框架，而非只看准确率。
items.why_en: It offers a principled framework for when multimodal systems should seek more evidence instead of just maximizing accuracy.

items.title_zh: 多带宽分布匹配蒸馏：分布匹配蒸馏与漂移模型的等价性
items.title_en: Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models
items.summary_zh: 一步生成模型持续受到研究者关注，漂移模型（Drifting Models）近期展现出较大潜力。已有工作揭示了扩散与流式生成模型（DFSGMs）与漂移模型之间的联系，但尚未建立漂移模型与广泛使用的蒸馏方法之间的精确对应关系。本文提出多带宽分布匹配蒸馏，并论证分布匹配蒸馏与漂移模型之间的等价性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Researchers are exploring effective one-step generative model continuously, and, Drifting Models (Deng et al., 2026), demonstrate great potential in one-step generation recently. There are works that reveal the connection between Diffusion & Flow Style Generative Models (DFSGMs) (Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2020a;b; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022) and Drifting Models (Li & Zhu, 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan et al., 2026). But no one has yet established a precise correspondence between the Drifting Model and the widely used distillation m…
items.why_zh: 建立两类一步生成方法的等价关系，有助于统一理论并简化高效生成模型的设计。
items.why_en: Establishing an equivalence between two one-step generation approaches can unify theory and simplify the design of efficient generative models.

items.title_zh: CityDeploy-Bench：面向多发射机网络部署的物理约束空间集合规划基准
items.title_en: CityDeploy-Bench: Benchmarking Physics-Grounded Spatial Set Planning for Multi-Transmitter Network Deployment
items.summary_zh: 在复杂的城市传播环境与全网干扰下，实现城市尺度的无线网络自动化部署仍具挑战。作者提出 CityDeploy-Bench，将多发射机部署重新表述为在统一射线追踪验证器下的“物理约束空间集合规划”问题。该基准把效用表示与规划动态分离开来，从而能在多种规划器之间受控地比较直接标量奖励、关系模型与高阶交互结构。实验得出了明确的结论。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automating city-scale wireless deployment remains challenging under complex urban propagation and network-wide interference. We introduce \textbf{CityDeploy-Bench}, a benchmark that reframes multi-transmitter deployment as \emph{physics-grounded spatial set planning} under a unified ray-tracing verifier. The benchmark separates utility representation from planning dynamics, enabling controlled comparison between direct scalar rewards, relational models, and higher-order interaction structures across diverse planners. Our experiments reveal a clea…
items.why_zh: 它为城市级无线部署提供了一个可复现、物理可验证的评测标准。
items.why_en: It provides a reproducible, physically verifiable benchmark for city-scale wireless deployment.

items.title_zh: 信用风险建模中的排序先验对齐：外部先验何时起作用？
items.title_en: Ranking Prior Alignment for Credit Risk Modeling: When Do External Priors Matter?
items.summary_zh: 冷启动信用评分——在标注数据稀缺、特征薄弱或模型容量有限时部署模型——是金融机器学习中反复出现的问题。当新的信贷产品上线时，违约标注数据稀少、特征管线不成熟，模型还必须以较小容量部署以避免过拟合。而常规防御手段只能作用于同样有限的数据，因此需要引入基于领域知识的外部正则化。作者提出“排序先验对齐”，一个模型无关的框架，用于蒸馏外部先验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cold-start credit scoring -- deploying models with scarce labeled data, weak features, or minimal capacity -- is a recurring problem in financial machine learning. When a new lending product launches, labeled default data is scarce, feature pipelines are immature, and models must be deployed with minimal capacity to avoid overfitting. Standard defenses operate on the same limited data; what is needed is a source of external regularization grounded in domain knowledge. We propose Ranking Prior Alignment, a model-agnostic framework that distills ex…
items.why_zh: 它指出了一个实用方向：在数据匮乏时用领域先验而非更多数据来稳定信用模型。
items.why_en: It points to a practical direction: regularizing credit models with domain priors when data is scarce.

items.title_zh: RideBench：面向网约车时序预测的大规模外生因素感知基准
items.title_en: RideBench: A Large-Scale Exogenous-Aware Benchmark for Ride-Hailing Time Series Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 作者发布大规模网约车时序数据集 Ride-Hailing，基于滴滴的市场数据合成，覆盖 200 个空间区域。该数据集跨越连续四年、粒度为半小时，并包含三类具有代表性的外生情景：天气扰动、节假日效应与大型活动影响。基于此，作者提出 RideBench，一个面向外生因素感知的综合预测基准，涵盖常规的提前一周预测，以及最多提前八周、最长 2688 步的长时程预测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We release Ride-Hailing, a large-scale ride-hailing time series dataset synthesized from DiDi's marketplace data across 200 spatial areas. Ride-Hailing spans four consecutive years at half-hourly granularity and covers three representative exogenous scenarios: Weather Disturbance, Holiday Effect, and Large-scale Event Impact. Built upon Ride-Hailing, we introduce RideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for exogenous-aware ride-hailing forecasting, covering both regular week-ahead forecasting and long-horizon 8-week-ahead forecasting with up to 2,688…
items.why_zh: 真实的外生冲击是网约车预测的难点，该数据集与基准为评估模型的鲁棒性提供了统一平台。
items.why_en: Exogenous shocks are the hard part of ride-hailing forecasting, and this dataset and benchmark give a common platform for testing robustness.

items.title_zh: 从单一提示到“剧目库”：演化功能性剧目实现 LLM 持续学习
items.title_en: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
items.summary_zh: 持续学习对大型语言模型而言仍是难题：模型需要在获取新技能与新知识的同时不损害已有能力。现有方法通常着力于精心设计参数更新方式；相比之下，提示优化避免昂贵的参数更新，并能在单个知识密集或推理任务上取得与 GRPO 等强化学习方法相当甚至更优的表现。由此引出一个自然的问题：提示能否支撑持续学习？作者提出让功能性“剧目库”（Repertoires）不断演化，从而赋能 LLM 的持续学习。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt…
items.why_zh: 它探索了不更新参数、仅靠演化提示来持续学习的新范式，有望大幅降低持续学习成本。
items.why_en: It explores continual learning without parameter updates by evolving prompts, potentially cutting the cost of adaptation.

items.title_zh: MC-TRCM：面向不完整移动与可穿戴心理健康特征视图的观测感知递归融合
items.title_en: MC-TRCM: Observation-Aware Recursive Fusion for Incomplete Mobile and Wearable Mental-Health Feature Views
items.summary_zh: 公开的移动与可穿戴心理健康数据集通常只提供汇总后的特征表，而非同步的原始传感器流；每条记录对应一次问卷或标签时点，可能混合手机/可穿戴汇总、既往症状评分、人口统计与临床变量以及来源可用性标记。为此作者提出模态条件化时序递归上下文模型（MC-TRCM），把每个特征来源保留为独立的 token，并将缺失情况本身纳入输入上下文。这一设计使模型在部分模态缺失时仍能进行观测感知的融合，为不完整多源健康数据的建模提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Public mobile and wearable mental-health datasets often provide summarized feature tables rather than synchronized raw sensor streams. In these releases, each anchor corresponds to a survey or label time and may combine phone or wearable summaries, prior symptom scores, demographics, clinical variables, and source-availability indicators. We propose the Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model (MC-TRCM), which preserves each feature source as a separate token and incorporates missingness as part of the input context. Observed sources…
items.why_zh: 心理健康数据中模态缺失十分普遍，该工作把缺失本身当作可用信息建模，为不完整多源数据的稳健融合提供了通用方案。
items.why_en: Missing modalities are the norm in mental-health data, and treating missingness as context offers a general route to robust fusion across incomplete sources.

items.title_zh: MotiveMob：将动机作为语义动作的闭环人类移动生成
items.title_en: MotiveMob: Motivation as Semantic Action for Closed-Loop Human Mobility Generation
items.summary_zh: 人类移动生成是城市研究中的重要任务，可为城市规划与交通管理合成轨迹数据。其本质可描述为一个“为何—何地—何时”的决策过程：人先形成移动意图，再决定对应活动发生的地点和时间。作者指出，现有许多移动生成方法并未显式刻画这一决策结构，因而在用户层面与时间分布发生偏移时表现受限。为此他们提出 MotiveMob，把动机作为语义动作来建模，构成闭环的移动生成框架，以更好应对分布漂移场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human mobility generation, an important task in urban research, synthesizes trajectory data for urban planning and transportation management. Human mobility can be characterized as a "why-where-when" decision process: people form an intention to move and then determine where and when the corresponding activity will take place. Trajectory generation under user-level and temporal distribution shifts may benefit from explicitly modeling this decision structure. However, many existing human mobility generation methods either represent behavioral inte…
items.why_zh: 把出行动机显式纳入生成过程，有望在分布漂移下产生更可信的合成轨迹，对城市规划与交通管理有直接价值。
items.why_en: Explicitly modeling motivation in trajectory generation could yield more reliable synthetic mobility data under distribution shift.

items.title_zh: 扩散模型记忆化的早期信号：基于盆地几何与循环去噪
items.title_en: Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型在训练早期表现出泛化能力，随后会逐步复现单个训练样本。标准检测方法只有在一次性生成几乎逐字复制训练样本时才能发现记忆化，这意味着已发布模型在被审计之前可能已经产生失败输出。作者提出，记忆化在被生成样本暴露之前就已编码在学习到的能量景观几何之中，并将这一状态称为“潜记忆化”。他们借助分数散度与盆地体积发现，训练样本周围会先形成局部化盆地，并使其与留出样本分离，从而为更早的审计提供信号。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before th…
items.why_zh: 若能在生成端暴露之前就预判记忆化，模型发布前的合规审计与风险预警将更为及时。
items.why_en: Detecting memorization before it surfaces in outputs would enable earlier auditing of released models.

items.title_zh: SR-TTA：面向抗干扰呼吸感知的空间冗余测试时自适应
items.title_en: SR-TTA: Spatial-Redundancy Test-Time Adaptation for Interference-Robust Respiration Sensing
items.summary_zh: 未来 6G 网络希望复用通信基础设施，把感知作为原生服务提供。本文研究无蜂窝大规模 MIMO 基站上的呼吸感知问题，需要把 64 天线信道融合成一条呼吸波形。现有手工设计的融合方案在良好条件下接近最优，但当强带内运动干扰落入呼吸频段时便会失效。作者表明，学习得到的复数权重波束成形器可以借助空间冗余恢复呼吸信号，并提出 SR-TTA 方法进行测试时自适应，以提升干扰条件下的鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Future 6G networks aim to expose sensing as a native service by reusing communication infrastructure. We study respiration sensing on a cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) base station, where a 64-antenna channel must be fused into a breathing waveform. The state-of-the-art hand-crafted fusion is near-optimal in benign conditions. It collapses, however, under strong in-band motion interference, whose frequency falls inside the respiration band. We show that a learned complex-weight beamformer recovers respiration by spatial nu…
items.why_zh: 把通信网络复用为原生感知服务是 6G 的关键方向，而抗干扰的鲁棒呼吸感知是其能否落地的核心问题之一。
items.why_en: Robust, interference-resilient sensing is central to the 6G vision of communication infrastructure doubling as a sensing service.

items.title_zh: Puffin：从粗粒度观测中概率化学习空间细节
items.title_en: Puffin: Probabilistic Learning of Spatial Detail From Coarse Observations
items.summary_zh: 高分辨率社会经济变量对城市规划、公共卫生、灾害响应与资源分配都十分重要，但在现实中，这类变量往往只在较粗的空间尺度上被观测到。作者提出 Puffin，一个用于统计分解的概率框架：以高分辨率卫星嵌入作为协变量，把粗粒度的总量拆分到更细的空间单元。与直接预测单一数值不同，Puffin 会为每个细粒度子区域学习一个概率分布，从而在提升分辨率的同时量化不确定性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-resolution socioeconomic variables are important for applications such as urban planning, public health, disaster response, and resource allocation. In practice, however, these variables are often observed only at a coarse spatial resolution. We introduce Puffin, a probabilistic framework for statistical disaggregation that raises the resolution of coarse totals using high-resolution satellite embeddings as covariates. Instead of predicting a single value for each fine-resolution subregion, Puffin learns a probability distribution and is tra…
items.why_zh: 以概率分布而非单点估计给出细粒度社会经济指标，使下游决策能够显式考虑不确定性。
items.why_en: Probabilistic, high-resolution socioeconomic estimates let downstream decisions account for uncertainty instead of relying on point predictions.

items.title_zh: 树模型中的区间值 SHAP
items.title_en: Interval-valued SHAP in Tree-Based Models
items.summary_zh: Shapley 值是最流行的特征归因解释方法之一，针对在表格数据上表现领先的树模型，已有高效的精确计算与估计方案。但已有研究指出，Shapley 值在面对现实中微小的变动时可能相当不稳健。本文提出基于不精确狄利克雷模型（IDM）的方法，通过量化并分析决策树与随机森林中 Shapley 值的区间范围来考察其稳健性，从而为树模型的归因结果提供不确定性刻画。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Shapley values are among the most popular feature-attribution explanations. Efficient approaches for computing/estimating Shapley values for tree-based models, which are state-of-the-art for tabular data sets, have been developed. However, it is known that Shapley values can be (highly) unrobust due to small and realistic changes. In this paper, we propose an imprecise Dirichlet model (IDM) based method to analyze the robustness of Shapley values in decision trees and random forests. Technically, it is done by quantifying and analyzing the interv…
items.why_zh: 给树模型的 SHAP 解释配上区间而非单点，让使用者了解归因结论在多大扰动范围内仍然成立。
items.why_en: Interval-valued SHAP reveals how stable a tree-based attribution really is under small perturbations.

items.title_zh: 训练于未来：时间序列预测中测试时自适应的延迟感知审计
items.title_en: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 面向时间序列预测的测试时自适应（TTA）方法会用新到达的真实标签来更新已部署模型或其小型适配器。但一个 H 步预测的标签要到 H 步之后才存在，真实数据管道还会带来额外延迟，因此这类更新可能隐含信息泄漏。作者构建了一个无泄漏实验框架：预测起点 s 的标签只在第 s+d 步（d≥H）才被释放用于更新，并在 TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA 四种近期 TTA 方法的公开代码中强制执行该规则，在各自骨干网络与检查点上跨五个数据集进行评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12232v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five…
items.why_zh: 如果 TTA 评测默认提前拿到标签，其报告的性能可能被高估；该审计为时间序列自适应研究确立了更严格的评测标准。
items.why_en: If TTA evaluations implicitly use future labels, reported gains may be inflated; this audit sets a stricter, leakage-free benchmark for forecasting adaptation.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：分布漂移下云负载预测的高效自适应在线学习
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 准确的负载预测对大规模云服务的弹性资源供给至关重要，但病毒式传播内容、产品发布和用户行为变化带来的分布漂移会让离线训练的模型迅速失效。朴素在线学习虽能恢复精度，却带来高昂的逐步计算开销。作者提出 AdaptLSTM：通过基于验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，并只执行选择性的定向更新。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 上，AdaptLSTM 以较低成本恢复了朴素在线学习方法 54% 的改进幅度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at…
items.why_zh: 在以低成本换取接近全量在线更新精度的同时，能显著提升漂移频繁场景下云资源调度的效率。
items.why_en: Capturing most of online learning's accuracy at a fraction of the cost directly benefits cloud resource provisioning under frequent drift.

items.title_zh: JevForest：面向预算受限特征获取的路径投票方法
items.title_en: JevForest: Path Voting for Budgeted Feature Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究在观测预算有限的条件下，如何选择要获取哪些信息来做预测。作者提出的 JevForest 是一种特征获取策略：它聚集来自自助采样（bootstrap）树的多条路径相关提议，按全局训练信息增益为其加权，并用一个共享的掩码分类器基于已获取的特征值进行预测；其在线实现则依据该策略选取语义问答。在小型平衡留出样本上，四问森林获取在 AG News 上取得 0.729 的准确率（n=48）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.10615v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Choosing which information to observe is central to prediction under limited observation budgets. We study JevForest, a feature acquisition policy that aggregates path-dependent proposals from bootstrapped trees, weights them by global training information gain, and predicts from the acquired values with a shared masked classifier. An online implementation queries Jev for semantic answers selected by this policy. On small balanced held-out samples, four-question forest acquisition achieves accuracy $0.729$ on AG News ($n=48$), compared with $0.…
items.why_zh: 为预算受限场景下的特征获取与主动信息选择提供了一种可在线执行的实用策略。
items.why_en: It offers a practical, online-deployable policy for choosing which information to acquire when observation budgets are limited.

items.title_zh: LadderEdit：面向 LLM 终身编辑的内存高效编辑级残差压缩
items.title_en: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
items.summary_zh: 大模型的终身编辑在模型获取后需要存储成千上万条编辑，主流做法是为每条编辑挂一个 LoRA 适配器，虽能保持行为但存储量线性增长。为此作者提出 LadderEdit，在每条编辑被获取后对其 LoRA 适配器进行压缩：每条编辑先以低秩“草图”形式廉价存储，随后在探针提示上检验该草图是否仍满足改写、泛化与局部性契约；通过检验的保留草图，未通过的则进一步处理以节省存储。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are…
items.why_zh: 它直击终身编辑中存储随编辑数量线性膨胀的痛点，在保持编辑行为的同时降低内存开销。
items.why_en: It targets the linear storage blow-up of lifelong LLM editing, cutting memory cost while preserving edit behavior.

items.title_zh: 面向持续机器遗忘的极小极大高斯机制
items.title_en: Minimax Gaussian Mechanisms for Continual Machine Unlearning
items.summary_zh: 机器遗忘旨在删除数据记录后更新已训练模型，使其效果接近精确重训，而不必重复整个训练过程。作者为顺序删除请求下的牛顿更新设计了高斯机制，并借助高斯差分隐私（GDP）及其自适应组合规则，证明整段发布的模型序列在统计上难以与匹配的精确重训区分。为在经验风险最小化中校准这些机制，他们还推导了牛顿近似误差的上界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11628v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine unlearning updates a trained model after records are deleted, aiming to match exact retraining without repeating the full training procedure. We develop Gaussian mechanisms for Newton updates under sequential deletion requests. Using Gaussian differential privacy (GDP) and its adaptive composition rule, we show that the full sequence of released models is statistically difficult to distinguish from matched exact retraining. To calibrate these mechanisms for empirical risk minimization, we derive upper bounds on the error of the Newton a…
items.why_zh: 为持续删除场景下的机器遗忘提供了可证明的隐私与统计不可区分性保证。
items.why_en: It provides provable privacy and indistinguishability guarantees for machine unlearning under continual deletion.

items.title_zh: σTransfer：μP 下从小网络向大网络迁移不确定性
items.title_en: $\sigma$Transfer: Uncertainty Transfer from Small to Large Networks under $\mu\mathrm{P}$
items.summary_zh: 拉普拉斯近似中的可靠预测不确定性高度依赖先验精度，但在数十亿参数的神经网络上做后验扫描来选取该精度代价高得难以承受。作者在最大更新参数化（μP）下推导出先验协方差的一种重缩放方式，使所选精度随模型宽度增长保持稳定，由此提出 σTransfer：在小模型上选定精度，再零样本迁移到远大的模型，而无需搜索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11668v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable predictive uncertainty in Laplace approximations depends critically on the prior precision, yet selecting it requires a posterior sweep that is prohibitively expensive for neural networks with billions of parameters. Under the Maximal Update Parametrization ($\mu\mathrm{P}$), we derive a rescaling of the prior covariance that makes the selected precision stable as model width grows. This leads to $\sigma\mathrm{Transfer}$: we select the precision on a smaller model and zero-shot transfer it to the much larger model, i.e., without searc…
items.why_zh: 让大模型的贝叶斯不确定性校准摆脱昂贵的后验扫描，可通过小模型零样本迁移完成。
items.why_en: It removes the prohibitive posterior sweep for uncertainty calibration in large models via zero-shot transfer from small ones.

items.title_zh: 大模型水印检测能否公开？
items.title_en: Could LLM Watermark Detection be Public?
items.summary_zh: 为追踪聊天机器人与智能体的输出，大模型水印日益流行，但检测器通常不公开，因为暴露检测器会让攻击者借助反馈进行定向修改。然而水印本身已经容易受到无信息篡改攻击。作者首先量化在从 token 级分数到二元判决的不同访问级别下，公开检测器是否会在部署中构成额外风险；随后提出一种分离密钥的公私水印方法，只公开其中一把密钥。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Watermarking large language models is popular for tracing chatbot and agentic outputs, yet detectors remain unreleased since exposing them could let attackers do targeted edits with the detector's feedback. However, watermarks are already vulnerable to uninformed tampering attacks. We thus first quantify whether a public detector would be an additional liability in a deployment setting at varying levels of access, from token-level scores to a binary verdict. Second, we introduce a split-key public-private watermarking method that exposes one ke…
items.why_zh: 它正面回应水印检测器能否公开这一安全与可审计性之间的核心权衡问题。
items.why_en: It directly addresses the core trade-off between watermark detector transparency and attack vulnerability.

items.title_zh: MARGIN：多智能体基础模型协作的运行时置信度校准
items.title_en: MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination
items.summary_zh: 当协调者比较来自多个异构基础模型的答案时，各响应者自报的置信度含义可能并不一致，且会随工作负载变化。论文提出 MARGIN（基于增量归一化的多智能体运行时分档），一种运行时校准方法：无需重训模型，也不需要留出校准集，仅从观测到的答案结果中学习各模型专属的置信度修正，并在置信度区间内跟踪近期准确率与自报置信度，用二者比值修正报告值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.22949v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: When a coordinator compares answers from heterogeneous foundation models, self-reported confidence may have different meanings across responders and changing workloads. This paper presents MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation), a runtime calibration method that learns model-specific confidence corrections from observed answer outcomes without retraining the models or requiring a held-out calibration set. MARGIN tracks recent accuracy and stated confidence within confidence bands, uses their ratio to correct report…
items.why_zh: 让多模型协作系统无需重训即可在运行时对齐各方置信度，提升协调决策的可靠性。
items.why_en: It aligns confidence across cooperating models at runtime, improving reliability of coordination decisions without retraining.

items.title_zh: CompOrca：面向指令微调数据的语料级合规标注
items.title_en: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data
items.summary_zh: 要研究微调如何塑造模型的拒绝与非合规行为，就必须知道训练样本中哪些是在拒绝或未能满足请求，但现有标注只覆盖规模远小于训练语料的评测集。作者发布 CompOrca，为 OpenOrca 语料的全部 4,233,923 条样本提供合规标签：每条样本由开源权重模型 LongCat-2.0（1.6T 参数）作为评判者经五次独立判定进行分类，一致合规占 94.75%，一致非合规的比例也被报告。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37807v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires knowing which training examples refuse or otherwise fail to fulfil the request. Existing annotations cover evaluation sets, which are far smaller than training corpora. We present CompOrca, compliance labels for all 4,233,923 examples of the OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters). The corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncom…
items.why_zh: 它把合规性标注扩展到完整训练语料规模，为研究微调与拒答行为提供数据基础。
items.why_en: It scales compliance annotation to an entire training corpus, enabling study of how fine-tuning shapes refusal behavior.

items.title_zh: Kimi 现代高速开源治理的 AI Native 实践｜QCon 上海
items.title_en: Kimi's AI-Native Practices for Modern High-Speed Open Source Governance | QCon Shanghai
items.summary_zh: Kimi 现代高速开源治理的 AI Native 实践｜QCon 上海 InfoQ-CN
items.summary_en: In a QCon Shanghai session, Kimi presents its AI-native practices for modern high-speed open source governance, describing how the team applies AI-native approaches to governing fast-moving open source projects. The item comes from an InfoQ-CN session listing; details of the methods and cases are in the original session page.
items.why_zh: 展示了大模型团队如何把 AI 原生思路用于大规模开源项目的治理与协作。
items.why_en: It shows how a large-model team applies AI-native thinking to governing and collaborating on large open source projects.

items.title_zh: 民间开发者发力：英伟达黑苹果开源驱动发布，16/20/30/40/50 系显卡都能用
items.title_en: Community Developer Open-Sources Nvidia macOS Driver Supporting GTX 16 and RTX 20/30/40/50 GPUs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，一位社区开发者 NullMoth 日前发布并开源了适用于 macOS 的英伟达显卡驱动。 根据项目介绍，该驱动支持 macOS 15 Sequoia 系统， 适配英伟达图灵架构及后续显卡，具体包括 GTX 16、RTX 20/30/40/50、TITAN RTX 以及支持的 Quadro / RTX 工作站显卡 。 该驱动实现了显示和 Metal 接口，该开发者测试了 RTX 5060 可用，RTX 5070/5080 报告可用，其他显卡有待测试。 开发者介绍，他实现了一个 macOS 驱动插件，该插件将 Metal 调用转换为 Vulkan，并将苹果的着色器格式转换为 SPIR-V。 IT之家注意到，目前已有国内用户测试了 RTX 5080、RTX 3060 Ti 显卡安装成功，macOS 系统可以正确显示显卡型号。 英伟达黑苹果开源驱动地址： https://github.com/nullmoth/nvidia-macos-driver
items.summary_en: Community developer NullMoth has released an open-source Nvidia GPU driver for macOS 15 Sequoia, covering Turing-and-later cards such as GTX 16, RTX 20/30/40/50, TITAN RTX and some Quadro/RTX workstation GPUs. The driver implements display and Metal support via a plugin that translates Metal calls into Vulkan and converts Apple shader formats to SPIR-V, with RTX 5060 tested working and some users reporting success on RTX 5080 and RTX 3060 Ti.
items.why_zh: 这是民间力量首次让近代英伟达显卡在 macOS 上获得可用的图形与 Metal 支持，对黑苹果社区意义重大。
items.why_en: It marks a rare community effort to bring modern Nvidia graphics and Metal support to macOS, a significant development for the Hackintosh community.

items.title_zh: CoreWeave 推出 Forge，打造 AI 推理全栈方案
items.title_en: AI inference gets a full stack as CoreWeave launches Forge
items.summary_zh: 据 SiliconANGLE 报道，云计算厂商 CoreWeave 推出名为 Forge 的新产品，定位为面向 AI 推理的全栈（full stack）方案。报道标题显示，Forge 试图把 AI 推理所需的各层能力整合在一起，供企业在 CoreWeave 平台上运行推理工作负载。目前公开信息有限，具体组件、定价与可用时间等细节尚未在摘要中披露。
items.summary_en: AI inference gets a full stack as CoreWeave launches Forge SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 推理需求正快速超过训练，CoreWeave 以全栈方式切入推理，反映云厂商正围绕推理环节展开新竞争。
items.why_en: As inference demand grows faster than training, CoreWeave's full-stack push signals intensifying competition among cloud providers around inference.

items.title_zh: 微软升级 Win11 的 AI 框架，实验性支持 GGUF 与 ONNX 原生本地推理
items.title_en: Microsoft Upgrades Windows ML with Experimental Native GGUF and ONNX Inference
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 昨日（10 月 8 日）发布博文，报道称微软正与 llama.cpp 和 GGUF 开源社区合作，在 Windows 11 系统上升级 Windows ML， 实验性原生支持 GGUF 与 ONNX 格式模型推理，并推出 Windows ML Runtime API。 在 Windows 与 Surface 十月活动中，微软介绍了 Windows ML 的最新进展。Windows ML 是微软面向 Windows 11 的本地 AI 推理框架，开发者可在设备端运行 AI 模型，构建文本生成、语音识别等应用，并减少对特定硬件优化的依赖。 微软表示通过社区合作，开发者现可通过 llama.cpp 的实验性集成，从 Hugging Face 导入 GGUF 模型并直接在本地运行。在性能方面，微软还携手英伟达公司，向 llama.cpp 及相关性能优化贡献代码。 Windows ML 新增实验性 Windows 原生推理路径，可运行 ONNX 与 GGUF 两类模型。该路径正式名称为 Windows ML Runtime API，微软称其具备更高性能、更深的系统集成及更细粒度的控制能力。 IT之家注：GGUF 是一种常用于本地运行大语言模型的模型文件格式。开发者可从 Hugging Face 等平台获取 GGUF 模型，并通过 lla…
items.summary_en: Microsoft is upgrading Windows ML on Windows 11 in partnership with the llama.cpp and GGUF communities, adding experimental native inference for GGUF and ONNX models plus a new Windows ML Runtime API. Developers can now import GGUF models from Hugging Face via an experimental llama.cpp integration, and Microsoft has contributed optimization code alongside Nvidia.
items.why_zh: 把 GGUF/ONNX 原生推理直接做进 Windows，意味着本地大模型运行正从第三方工具走向系统级能力。
items.why_en: Baking native GGUF/ONNX inference into Windows moves local LLM execution from third-party tools toward a system-level capability.

items.title_zh: Frore 发布 LiquidJet Diamond：冷板集成金刚石均热板，效能进一步提升
items.title_en: Frore Unveils LiquidJet Diamond With Diamond Vapor Chamber in the Cold Plate
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，Frore Systems 当地时间昨日宣布推出 LiquidJet Diamond。这一产品在其此前的 3D 超短回路多级可定制冷板 LiquidJet 基础上 额外添加了一层集成金刚石晶圆的均热板 ，可精准覆盖热点位置。 Frore Systems 宣称 LiquidJet Diamond 可冷却功率密度达到 770 W/cm² 的极限热点，在 LiquidJet 的基础上 额外实现 10℃ 的 GPU 热点温度降低、10% 的词元能效提升 。 相关阅读： 《 Frore 推出 DLC 液冷 3D 冷板 LiquidJet：支持 1400+W AI XPU 热负载 》 《 Frore 展示 LiquidJet 散热方案，为英伟达 Rubin GPU 压制 1950W 高温 》 《 Frore 发布 0.5U 托盘液冷系统 LiquidJet Nexus，热交换效率提升 75% 》
items.summary_en: Frore Systems announced LiquidJet Diamond, which adds a diamond-wafer vapor chamber to its existing LiquidJet 3D cold plate to target hot spots precisely. The company claims it can cool hot spots at 770 W/cm² power density while delivering an extra 10°C GPU hot-spot reduction and 10% better token energy efficiency over LiquidJet.
items.why_zh: AI 加速芯片功耗与功率密度持续攀升，金刚石均热板这类材料级散热创新正成为维持性能的关键。
items.why_en: As AI accelerator power density keeps rising, materials-level cooling innovations like diamond vapor chambers are becoming essential to sustaining performance.

items.title_zh: 合资燃油车也能装AI 大脑？君越这次合作有点意思|别克全新君越|豆包ai大模型|合资燃油车_新浪新闻
items.title_en: Buick LaCrosse Partners With Doubao AI Model, Bringing an 'AI Brain' to Joint-Venture Fuel Cars
items.summary_zh: 合资燃油车也能装AI 大脑？君越这次合作有点意思|别克全新君越|豆包ai大模型|合资燃油车_新浪新闻 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: According to Sina News, Buick's new LaCrosse is partnering with the Doubao AI large model, bringing AI capabilities to a joint-venture gasoline car. Specific configurations, timing and feature details were not disclosed in the available information.
items.why_zh: 合资燃油车引入国产大模型，说明 AI 上车正从新势力电动车扩展开来，成为智能座舱的新卖点。
items.why_en: A joint-venture gasoline car adopting a domestic large language model shows AI is spreading beyond EV startups and becoming a selling point for smart cockpits.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 年化营收被曝接近 500 亿美元，比预期少了约 200 亿
items.title_en: OpenAI's annualized revenue reported near $50B, about $20B below earlier expectations
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，据金融时报报道，一份向 OpenAI 投资者披露的最新财务文件显示，其实际年化营收相较于公司此前释放的 预期缺口达约 200 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,342.49 亿元人民币） 。 OpenAI 向投资者最新披露，截至 9 月底，其年化营收正逼近 500 亿美元 （现汇率约合 3,356.23 亿元人民币） 。这一数字大幅低于主流媒体上月的报道，彼时媒体根据此前向投资人提供的数据，估算其年化营收高达 700 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4,698.72 亿元人民币） 。 知情人士透露，这一数据差异源于投资人试图将 OpenAI 的年化营收与其竞争对手 Anthropic 进行直接横向对比。然而，两家公司在财务统计口径上并不一致：Anthropic 将通过亚马逊云科技 AWS 和谷歌云等云厂商合作伙伴销售所产生的营收一并计入，而 OpenAI 的统计则剔除了这部分合作收入。 这一营收数据（以及 Anthropic 的同类指标）是评估全球 AI 整体市场需求最关键的风向标，同时也是巨额算力基础设施投资与二级股票市场上涨的核心支撑。 在金融时报发布该报道后，美股科技板块应声大跌，纳斯达克 100 指数收跌 1.4%。其中英伟达收跌 2.9%，甲骨文下挫 5.5%，美光科技下跌 4.8%。
items.summary_en: A Financial Times report citing financial documents shown to OpenAI investors says OpenAI's annualized revenue was approaching $50 billion at the end of September, roughly $20 billion below the ~$70 billion figure media had estimated from earlier investor data. The gap stems from differing accounting: Anthropic counts revenue from cloud partners such as AWS and Google Cloud, while OpenAI excludes it. After the report, the Nasdaq 100 fell 1.4%, with Nvidia down 2.9%, Oracle 5.5% and Micron 4.8%.
items.why_zh: OpenAI 的营收规模是判断全球 AI 真实需求与算力投资可持续性的核心指标，口径差异引发的预期修正直接冲击了科技股。
items.why_en: OpenAI's revenue scale is a key gauge of real global AI demand and the sustainability of compute investment, and the accounting-driven revision of expectations hit tech stocks directly.

items.title_zh: 知情人士称DeepSeek新一轮融资超800亿元 月之暗面估值约500亿美元
items.title_en: Sources Say DeepSeek's New Round Tops 80 Billion Yuan as Moonshot Valued at About $50 Billion
items.summary_zh: 知情人士称DeepSeek新一轮融资超800亿元 月之暗面估值约500亿美元 茉莉花新闻网
items.summary_en: Citing people familiar with the matter, a report says DeepSeek's new funding round exceeds 80 billion yuan, while Moonshot AI is valued at roughly $50 billion. Neither figure has been officially confirmed, and terms and investors were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这将是国内 AI 大模型领域规模罕见的融资，直接反映头部模型公司在资本市场的估值水平。
items.why_en: If accurate, the round would be one of the largest in China's AI model sector, highlighting how investors value leading LLM companies.

items.title_zh: 马斯克 SpaceX 将收购全美低频段频谱牌照组合，美国三大电信股盘后跌超 5%
items.title_en: SpaceX to acquire nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio; US telecom stocks fall over 5% after hours
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 9 日消息，路透社昨日（10 月 8 日）发布博文，报道称全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）旗下航天公司 SpaceX 已达成协议， 收购覆盖全美用于移动通信的低频段频谱牌照组合，为其星链移动（Starlink Mobile）服务直接进入美国电信市场铺路。 报道称 SpaceX 此次收购的是私募股权公司 Grain Management 所持有的全美 800 MHz 低频段频谱组合，交易仍需获得美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）批准。该频段最高包含 14 MHz 成对低频频谱，低频信号穿透力强，有助于改善室内、户外及传统蜂窝网络盲区的覆盖。 SpaceX 表示，星链移动现有的全球 2 GHz 中频频谱可提供较高带宽容量，而新增的 800 MHz 低频频谱将解决信号穿透障碍的关键技术缺口，使其能够构建“卫星 + 地面”混合网络。 埃隆 · 马斯克称，这笔交易是“非常大的交易”，并表示低频频谱是 SpaceX 在美国提供完整手机覆盖所需的“频谱拼图最后一块关键部分”。公司称，该交易将为星链移动成为美国主要移动运营商扫清重要障碍。 受竞争加剧和潜在价格战担忧影响，美国三大无线运营商股价在盘后交易中集体走低。市场数据显示，AT&T 一度下跌约 6.75%，T-Mobile 下跌约 5.4%，Verizon 下跌约 5%。IT之家附上相关截图如下：
items.summary_en: SpaceX has agreed to buy Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum portfolio, subject to FCC approval, adding up to 14 MHz of paired low-band airwaves. Musk called low-band spectrum the "last key piece of the spectrum puzzle" for full US mobile coverage, complementing Starlink Mobile's 2 GHz mid-band holdings in a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network. Fears of tougher competition and a price war pushed AT&T down about 6.75%, T-Mobile 5.4% and Verizon 5% after hours.
items.why_zh: 这笔交易可能让星链移动直接切入美国移动通信市场，重塑运营商竞争格局并引发价格战担忧。
items.why_en: The deal could let Starlink Mobile enter the US wireless market directly, reshaping carrier competition and stoking price-war concerns.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 为开源项目推出免费 AI 安全扫描
items.title_en: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
items.summary_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，Anthropic 推出面向开源项目的免费 AI 安全扫描服务。该消息目前披露的信息较为有限，主要指向 Anthropic 将其 AI 能力用于帮助开源社区发现安全问题。具体覆盖范围、技术细节与上线方式等有待官方进一步说明。开源软件被广泛嵌入各类基础设施，其安全状况直接关系到下游大量系统的稳定与可信。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects The Verge
items.why_zh: 开源代码是大量关键系统的底座，AI 辅助的安全扫描有望降低社区发现和修复漏洞的门槛。
items.why_en: Open-source code underpins many critical systems, so AI-assisted scanning could lower the barrier to finding and fixing vulnerabilities in the community.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出面向关键基础设施与开源的网络防御计划
items.title_en: Anthropic launches cyber defense program for infrastructure and open-source
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布启动一项网络安全防御计划，重点覆盖关键基础设施与开源领域。该计划将把其 AI 能力用于网络防护场景，帮助相关机构应对安全威胁。消息由 StreetInsider 报道，具体合作方、技术细节与落地时间尚未披露。此举显示 AI 公司正加快向安全防御这一高敏感、高价值领域延伸。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches cyber defense program for infrastructure and open-source StreetInsider
items.why_zh: AI 头部公司切入网络安全防御，可能重塑基础设施与开源生态的安全防护方式。
items.why_en: A leading AI firm entering cyber defense could reshape how infrastructure and open-source software are protected.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 启动面向关键基础设施与开源的安全计划
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Cyber Mission for Critical Infrastructure, Open Source
items.summary_zh: 据 Unite.AI 报道，Anthropic 启动了一项网络安全使命/计划，重点面向关键基础设施与开源领域。报道显示，Anthropic 希望借助其 AI 能力增强这些领域的安全防护。目前公开信息有限，计划的具体内容、合作方与实施方式尚未充分披露。关键基础设施与开源软件是现代数字经济的共同底座，一旦出现安全问题，影响往往波及广泛。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Cyber Mission for Critical Infrastructure, Open Source Unite.AI
items.why_zh: 把 AI 能力投向关键基础设施与开源安全，触及的是影响面最广、最不容有失的数字底座。
items.why_en: Directing AI capabilities at critical infrastructure and open-source security targets the broadest-reaching and least fault-tolerant parts of the digital stack.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 为 Claude 推出仪表盘与动画工具
items.title_en: Anthropic launches dashboard, animation tools for Claude
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，Anthropic 为其 Claude 产品推出了一款仪表盘以及动画相关工具。新功能意在拓展 Claude 的可用场景，让用户在使用模型时获得更直观的管理界面与内容生成能力。目前报道未披露这些工具的具体功能范围、上线范围与定价信息。这延续了 Anthropic 围绕 Claude 持续扩充产品功能的节奏。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches dashboard, animation tools for Claude Reuters
items.why_zh: Claude 从对话模型向带管理界面与创作工具的完整产品演进，反映大模型竞争转向产品体验。
items.why_en: Claude's expansion into dashboards and creation tools shows model competition shifting toward product experience.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 营收据报比此前预期少 200 亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.summary_zh: 此前有报道称 OpenAI 的年化营收约为 700 亿美元，但一份最新报告称其实际数字远低于这一水平，按标题说法少了约 200 亿美元。这意味着 OpenAI 的年化营收可能约为 500 亿美元，与外界此前的乐观预期存在明显差距。该消息若属实，将影响市场对 AI 头部公司商业化能力的判断，也可能波及相关投资与估值预期。
items.summary_en: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
items.why_zh: 营收预期差距直接影响市场对 AI 头部公司商业化能力和估值的信心。
items.why_en: The revenue gap could reshape expectations for AI leaders' commercialization and valuations.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策，禁止模型滥用与干预选举
items.title_en: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新了其使用政策，明确禁止在极端情况下反复滥用 Claude 的行为，但正常的用户不满与批评仍被允许。新规还覆盖选举干预、欺骗性宣传、武器软件以及监控等用途。此举显示 AI 公司在模型安全与滥用治理上进一步收紧边界，也为行业使用规范提供了参考。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.
items.why_zh: 这反映 AI 公司正主动划定模型滥用红线，影响用户与开发者的合规预期。
items.why_en: It shows AI firms tightening guardrails on model abuse, shaping compliance expectations.

items.title_zh: Joseph Fargnoli 推出 RITRE 公司思想领导力博客系列，聚焦 AI、社会创业与工程创新
items.title_en: Joseph Fargnoli Launches RITRE Corporation Thought Leadership Blog Series on Artificial Intelligence, Social Entrepreneurship, and Engineering Innovation
items.summary_zh: Joseph Fargnoli 宣布推出 RITRE Corporation 的思想领导力博客系列，主题涵盖人工智能、社会创业与工程创新。该系列以公司名义发布，相关消息通过 Yahoo Finance 传播。由于披露信息有限，目前尚不清楚博客的具体篇目、发布时间与内容细节。
items.summary_en: Joseph Fargnoli Launches RITRE Corporation Thought Leadership Blog Series on Artificial Intelligence, Social Entrepreneurship, and Engineering Innovation Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 企业通过博客输出观点，是参与 AI 与社会创新议题讨论的一种方式。
items.why_en: Corporate thought leadership blogs offer a way to join AI and social innovation conversations.

items.title_zh: 《今日美国》起诉 OpenAI，索赔逾 2.5 亿美元
items.title_en: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
items.summary_zh: 据路透社此前报道，USA Today 公司及其旗下多家地方报纸起诉 OpenAI，指控其复制“数十万篇”文章用于训练 AI 模型。在周四提交的诉状中，该出版商要求超过 2.5 亿美元的赔偿，称 OpenAI 未经授权使用其内容，对旗下媒体造成了“真实且持续”的伤害。这是针对 OpenAI 的一系列版权诉讼中的最新一起，此前《纽约时报》《The Intercept》、CNET 等也已发起法律行动。
items.summary_en: USA Today Co., along with the several local newspapers it owns, is suing OpenAI over claims that the company copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its AI models, as reported earlier by Reuters . In a filing on Thursday , the publisher asks for damages of more than $250 million, alleging OpenAI's unauthorized use of its content "has done real and continuing" harm to its outlets. This is just the latest in a string of copyright lawsuits filed against OpenAI. In addition to a copyright lawsuit filed by The New York Times , OpenAI is also facing legal action from The Intercept , CNET…
items.why_zh: 主流媒体接连起诉，凸显生成式 AI 训练数据版权争议正在升级。
items.why_en: The growing lawsuits highlight escalating copyright disputes over AI training data.

items.title_zh: 传 Anthropic IPO 文件显示去年亏损超 400 亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO docs reportedly reveal over $40 billion in losses last year
items.summary_zh: 据 Mashable 报道，Anthropic 的 IPO 相关文件据称显示其去年亏损超过 400 亿美元。该数字若属实，将凸显这家 AI 公司在高速扩张期面临的巨大成本压力。目前信息来自媒体报道，官方尚未公开确认文件细节与亏损构成的完整口径。这一消息也让外界更关注头部 AI 公司的盈利路径与上市前景。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO docs reportedly reveal over $40 billion in losses last year Mashable
items.why_zh: 巨额亏损传闻直指前沿 AI 商业模式的成本难题，也牵动其上市估值预期。
items.why_en: Reported massive losses highlight the cost challenge of frontier AI business models and shape IPO expectations.

items.title_zh: GM launches AI-powered platform for streamlining fleet management
items.title_en: GM launches AI-powered platform for streamlining fleet management
items.summary_zh: GM launches AI-powered platform for streamlining fleet management WardsAuto
items.summary_en: GM has launched an AI-powered platform designed to streamline fleet management, WardsAuto reports. The platform targets fleet operations to improve efficiency. Specific features, launch timing and vehicle coverage were not detailed.
items.why_zh: 传统车企将 AI 用于车队运营，是 AI 进入商用出行与售后服务链条的又一信号。
items.why_en: A legacy automaker applying AI to fleet operations signals AI's expansion into commercial mobility services.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 首次在政策中禁止对 Claude 施加“虐待或残酷行为”
items.title_en: Anthropic bans ‘abusive or cruel behavior’ toward Claude
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 一年多来首次更新使用政策，以覆盖选举干预、武器研发、监控、健康与金融用途等新的高风险滥用情形。其中最引人注目的变化，是明确禁止对 Claude 施加“持续且不必要的虐待或残酷行为”。去年 8 月，该公司曾表示作为“模型福利”研究的一部分，允许 Claude 主动结束与“持续有害或辱骂性”用户的对话；此次更新称终止对话仍是“主要执行手段”。这意味着 AI 公司开始把模型自身受到的对待纳入正式政策范畴。
items.summary_en: Anthropic is making changes to its usage policy for the first time in over a year to reflect new and high-risk cases of misuse - including election interference, weapons development, surveillance, and health and financial uses. But one of the most significant changes prohibits "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward Claude. Last August, the company announced it would allow Claude to end conversations with "persistently harmful or abusive" users as part of its research into "model welfare." The new update says that terminating conversations is still the "primary enforcement me…
items.why_zh: 这是把“对模型的虐待行为”写入正式使用政策的少见案例，反映“模型福利”议题正从研究走向治理。
items.why_en: It is a rare case of mistreatment of a model being written into a formal usage policy, showing 'model welfare' moving from research toward governance.

items.title_zh: Google launches Gemini AI workplace agent that can write code and run tasks, company says
items.title_en: Google launches Gemini AI workplace agent that can write code and run tasks, company says
items.summary_zh: Google launches Gemini AI workplace agent that can write code and run tasks, company says CBS News
items.summary_en: According to CBS News, Google has launched a Gemini AI workplace agent capable of writing code and running tasks. Details remain limited, but the move extends Gemini into automated task execution at work and is seen as Google's latest step in competing with OpenAI and Microsoft in enterprise AI.
items.why_zh: 职场智能体是当前大模型商业化的主战场，谷歌此举直接加剧企业级 AI 竞争。
items.why_en: Workplace agents are the key battleground for commercializing large models, and Google's move intensifies enterprise AI competition.

items.title_zh: 针对麦当劳的 AI 定价诉讼引发新的反垄断问题
items.title_en: AI pricing lawsuit against McDonald's raises new antitrust questions
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，一起围绕麦当劳使用 AI 定价的诉讼引发了新的反垄断议题。报道摘要未披露原告身份、具体指控与诉求等细节，但核心争议在于：当算法被用于动态定价时，现有反垄断框架是否足以应对。该案可能为 AI 定价工具的合规边界提供重要参考。
items.summary_en: AI pricing lawsuit against McDonald's raises new antitrust questions Reuters
items.why_zh: 算法定价是否构成价格合谋或价格歧视，正成为反垄断执法的新前沿。
items.why_en: Whether algorithmic pricing amounts to collusion or discrimination is becoming a new frontier for antitrust enforcement.

items.title_zh: 谷歌推出 Gemini AI 智能体，对标 OpenAI 与微软
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini AI Agent to Compete With OpenAI and Microsoft
items.summary_zh: 据 Barron's 报道，谷歌发布 Gemini AI 智能体，意在与企业级 AI 市场上的 OpenAI 和微软展开竞争。报道聚焦于这一发布对竞争格局的意义，而非具体功能细节。结合同期消息，谷歌正把 Gemini 从聊天助手推进到可跨应用执行任务的职场智能体形态。
items.summary_en: Google Launches Gemini AI Agent to Compete With OpenAI and Microsoft Barron's
items.why_zh: 谷歌、OpenAI 与微软在企业智能体上的三方角力，将决定下一阶段 AI 平台格局。
items.why_en: The three-way race among Google, OpenAI, and Microsoft in enterprise agents will shape the next phase of AI platforms.

items.title_zh: 又一里程碑时刻：深开鸿宣布开鸿开发者注册量突破 20 万
items.title_en: Kaihong developer registrations surpass 200,000, Shenzhen Kaihong says
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，深开鸿官方今日发布喜报， 宣布开鸿开发服务平台开发者注册量突破 20 万 （统计数据截止：2026 年 10 月 8 日）。 据IT之家此前报道，今年 8 月，深圳开鸿数字产业发展有限公司 CEO 王成录宣布： 深开鸿贡献 OpenHarmony 主干代码达 1000 万行 ！这是一个值得纪念的里程碑！ 四年来，深开鸿在开源社区里每敲下一行代码，都是对“技术立命”的践行，对“生态共建”的承诺，是深开鸿在开源社区交出的答卷，更是献给开源鸿蒙生态的一份厚礼！ 从 0 到 1000 万，这不仅是量的积累，更是我们聚焦操作系统核心技术、深耕基础软件四年的决心印证！ 目前，WPS、微信、QQ 也已正式登陆 KaihongOS 桌面版（x86）。据深开鸿官方介绍，此次版本通过深开鸿自研技术方案（非容器）兼容运行微信等主流应用， 运行性能无限接近原生 。
items.summary_en: Shenzhen Kaihong announced that developer registrations on its Kaihong development platform have exceeded 200,000. In August, CEO Wang Chenglu said the company had contributed 10 million lines of code to the OpenHarmony mainline. WPS, WeChat, and QQ have also arrived on KaihongOS desktop (x86) via its self-developed non-container compatibility approach.
items.why_zh: 开发者与应用规模是衡量国产开源鸿蒙生态成熟度的关键指标。
items.why_en: Developer and app numbers are key indicators of how mature the domestic OpenHarmony ecosystem has become.

items.title_zh: 谷歌推出可完全离线转录会议的 AI 笔记应用
items.title_en: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
items.summary_zh: 谷歌发布实验性笔记应用 Google AI Edge Foresight，可完全离线转录会议与音频文件，免费使用，运行于 macOS，基于其端侧模型 EmbeddingGemma 2。与 Granola、Wispr Flow 等 AI 笔记应用类似，Foresight 会总结会议内容，并提供用户自行记笔记的空间。谷歌表示，用户在会议中记下的速记要点，会依据转录内容被整理成“润色后的笔记”。完全离线意味着音频数据无需上传云端。
items.summary_en: Google has released an experimental note-taking app that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline, as reported earlier by TechCrunch . The app, called Google AI Edge Foresight , is free to use and runs on macOS using the company's on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model . Similar to AI note-taking apps like Granola and Wispr Flow, Foresight summarizes your meetings while providing a space where you can take your own notes. Google says you can jot down shorthand bullet points during your meeting, and the app will transform them into "polished notes" based on the information in the tran…
items.why_zh: 端侧模型让会议转录在本地完成，对隐私敏感的职场场景具有实际价值。
items.why_en: On-device models keep meeting transcription local, which matters for privacy-sensitive workplace use.

items.title_zh: Waymo 获 50 亿美元贷款：未来将推动无人驾驶出租车扩张，入局欧洲、日本等市场
items.title_en: Waymo secures $5B loan to expand robotaxi service into Europe and Japan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，自动驾驶技术公司 Waymo 近日宣布获得 50 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 335.62 亿元人民币） 贷款，融资方包括黑石、太平洋投资管理公司、Sixth Street 等。 据悉，这是 Waymo 首次进行债务融资。 这笔资金将用于推动无人驾驶出租车扩张 ， 并帮助 Waymo 入局美国、欧洲和日本市场 。 截至目前，Waymo 一直依靠母公司 Alphabet 及外部投资者提供资金。今年 2 月，Waymo 从投资者处筹集了 160 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,073.99 亿元人民币） 股权融资，公司估值因此达到 1,260 亿美元 （现汇率约合 8,457.7 亿元人民币） 。 此外，该公司曾于 2024 年完成 56 亿美元 （现汇率约合 375.9 亿元人民币） C 轮融资，2021 年融资 25 亿美元 （现汇率约合 167.81 亿元人民币） ，2020 年融资 32 亿美元 （现汇率约合 214.8 亿元人民币） 。
items.summary_en: Waymo has secured a $5 billion loan from lenders including Blackstone, PIMCO, and Sixth Street — its first debt financing — to expand its robotaxi service and enter markets in the US, Europe, and Japan. The company previously raised $16 billion in equity in February at a $126 billion valuation, plus a $5.6 billion Series C in 2024.
items.why_zh: 首次债务融资显示 Waymo 正从长期投入转向规模化商业扩张，也为自动驾驶行业提供了新的资本样本。
items.why_en: Its first debt financing signals Waymo is shifting from heavy investment to scaled commercial expansion, offering a new capital model for autonomous driving.

items.title_zh: 谷歌发布一站式 Gemini 职场智能体
items.title_en: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
items.summary_zh: 谷歌在 Gemini at Work 活动上宣布推出一款“通用”Gemini AI 智能体，可在后台跨应用、跨设备工作。该工具将集成在 Gemini Enterprise 应用中，用户可在单一界面与智能体对话并派发任务。除在 Gmail、Drive、Docs、Sheets、Calendar 等 Workspace 应用内直接工作外，用户还可通过手机、桌面端、网页以及 Slack、Microsoft 365 等第三方应用与之交互。由于运行在云端，智能体可以持续在后台执行任务。
items.summary_en: Google is launching a "universal" Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background. The tool, announced as part of the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, will be available within the Gemini Enterprise app, allowing users to chat with the Gemini agent and assign it tasks from a single interface. In addition to having Gemini work directly inside Workspace apps like Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, and others, users can interact with the agent from their mobile device, desktop computer, the web, and third-party apps like Slack or Microsoft 365. Since it runs in the clou…
items.why_zh: 谷歌把智能体做成企业工作流的统一入口，直接对标 OpenAI 与微软的同类产品。
items.why_en: Google is positioning its agent as a single entry point into enterprise workflows, directly challenging OpenAI and Microsoft.

items.title_zh: 谷歌推出职场 AI 智能体，可像同事一样工作
items.title_en: Google Launches Workplace AI Agent That Acts Like Colleague
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance UK 报道，谷歌发布了一款面向职场场景的 AI 智能体，定位是能够像同事一样参与工作。报道标题强调该智能体可以承担工作任务、扮演类似团队成员的角色，但现有摘要未提供功能细节、可用范围、发布时间或技术底座等具体信息。此举显示谷歌正把 AI 智能体推向企业办公场景，与当前科技巨头竞逐“工作智能体”的趋势一致。
items.summary_en: Google Launches Workplace AI Agent That Acts Like Colleague Yahoo Finance UK
items.why_zh: 谷歌入局职场智能体，意味着 AI 正从问答工具向能独立承担任务的“数字同事”演进。
items.why_en: Google's entry into workplace agents shows AI is moving from Q&A tools toward 'digital colleagues' that can take on tasks.

items.title_zh: 你能放心让 Meta 的 Muse 或 OpenAI 的 Dots 打理生活吗？
items.title_en: Can you trust Meta’s Muse or OpenAI’s Dots to run your life?
items.summary_zh: The Verge 资深 AI 记者 Hayden Field 做客节目，讨论面向普通消费者的 AI 智能体新浪潮。此前 AI 爱好者已通过自建的 OpenClaw 方案使用智能体，还一度带动 Mac Mini 销量上升；而 Meta 的 Muse、OpenAI 的 Dots 以及 xAI 的 Grok Bot 的发布，把易用的智能体带给了数百万用户。其中 Muse 和 Dots 的发布最为高调，两者定位相近，常被放在一起比较。节目围绕这些智能体是否值得信任、能否真正接管日常生活展开讨论。
items.summary_en: My Decoder guest today is Hayden Field, The Verge ’s senior AI reporter, and we’re discussing the new wave of consumer-friendly AI agents. If you’ve been paying attention to this space, you know AI enthusiasts have been using agents for a minute now — homebrew OpenClaw setups led to a surge in Mac Mini sales earlier this year. But the launches of Meta’s Muse, OpenAI’s Dots, and xAI’s Grok Bot have brought easy-to-use agents to millions. Muse and Dots have had the highest-profile product launches, and they’re fascinating to pit against each other. Both Meta and OpenAI have decided to pitch thes…
items.why_zh: 消费级智能体开始大规模落地，信任与可靠性成为它们能否接管个人事务的关键。
items.why_en: As consumer agents reach millions, trust and reliability become the key test for letting them run your life.

items.title_zh: Suki 推出临床决策支持功能 Ask，由 Wolters Kluwer UpToDate AI API 驱动

items.summary_en: Suki launches ‘Ask’ feature for clinical decision support driven by Wolters Kluwer UpToDate AI API Fierce Healthcare
items.why_zh: 把权威医学知识库接入临床工作流，可能提升诊疗效率与决策质量。
items.why_en: Embedding an authoritative medical knowledge base into clinical workflows could improve decision quality and efficiency.

items.title_zh: 谷歌云发布 Gemini Agent，定位“通用工作智能体”
items.title_en: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent as a 'Universal Work Agent'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，谷歌云今天在 Gemini at Work 2026 发布会上宣布，面向企业客户推出 Gemini 智能体（Gemini Agent）。这款产品定位“通用工作智能体”， 支持 Gemini Enterprise 、Workspace 以及第三方服务 。 谷歌表示，Gemini Agent 只需要用户给出目标就能完成工作，支持回答问题、处理知识型工作、创建媒体内容，以及编写程序。 例如，当你的经理用邮件要求你制作项目最近进展 PPT 时，Workspace Intelligence 会认为该任务可以由 AI 完成，用户只需点一下按钮就能交给 Gemini 继续。 除了充当个人助理之外，Gemini 智能体还可以用作“团队成员”。它可以在团队中担任 PM、财务分析师等。 IT之家注意到， 目前该智能体支持 Gemini 和 Claude 模型 ，未来还将兼容各种闭源、开源模型。官方将提供 API，让开发者将 Gemini Agent 集成到第三方应用中。 Gemini 智能体当前处于私人预览阶段，预计很快将面向符合条件的 Workspace 客户广泛开放，支持部分 Business 和 Enterprise 方案。
items.summary_en: At its Gemini at Work 2026 event, Google Cloud unveiled Gemini Agent, a 'universal work agent' for enterprise customers that works across Gemini Enterprise, Workspace and third-party services. Given only a goal, it can answer questions, handle knowledge work, create media and write code, and can also act as a team member such as a PM or financial analyst. It currently supports Gemini and Claude models, with more open and closed models plus an API planned; it is in private preview ahead of a broader Workspace rollout.
items.why_zh: 谷歌把智能体嵌入 Workspace 企业工作流，标志办公 AI 从助手向可执行任务的“数字同事”升级。
items.why_en: By embedding an agent in Workspace workflows, Google signals office AI is upgrading from assistant to task-executing 'digital colleague'.

items.why_en: GPT-6 could raise the capability ceiling again, while the Intelligent UI points to a change in how users interact with ChatGPT.

items.title_zh: Counterpoint 数据：晶圆代工 2.0 营收 2026Q2 达 966 亿美元，同比增长 25%
items.title_en: Counterpoint: Foundry 2.0 Revenue Hits $96.6B in Q2 2026, Up 25% YoY
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 8 日消息，研究机构 Counterpoint Research 在 9 月 29 日报告称，全球晶圆代工 2.0 市场营业收入总额在 2026 年第 2 季度达到 966 亿美元， 同比增长 25% 、 环比增长 11%， 增速较上一季度有所提升。 ▲ 图源：Counterpoint Research 从分类来看，纯晶圆代工行业营收同比增长 29% 至 549 亿美元；非存储 IDM 营收同比增长 19%；OSAT 营收同比增长 22%、环比增长 12%，达 126 亿美元；光罩（掩膜）及其它则同比增长 6%。 台积电以 402 亿美元一家贡献整体晶圆代工 2.0 营收的 42% ；营收同比增长 34%、环比增长 12%；机构预计其营收全年增幅将达到 43% 左右。台积电以外的纯晶圆代工厂营收同比增长 18%，其中中芯国际增幅达到 36%。英特尔晶圆代工同比增长 31%。 机构预计，未来五年内将有超过 1.3 亿颗 GPU 和 AI ASIC 搭载采用先进封装技术的计算侧内存出货，从而创造近 2 万亿美元的计算相关营收；台积电 CoWoS 供需缺口今年将维持在 20% 左右，而 2027 年将缩窄至 10%。 参考 Global Foundry 2.0 Revenue Rises 25% YoY to a Record $96.6 Billion in Q2…
items.summary_en: Counterpoint Research reports the global Foundry 2.0 market reached $96.6 billion in Q2 2026, up 25% year over year and 11% quarter over quarter. TSMC alone accounted for 42% of revenue at $40.2 billion, while SMIC grew 36% and Intel Foundry 31%. The firm also expects CoWoS supply-demand gap to stay around 20% this year before narrowing to 10% in 2027.
items.why_zh: 该数据反映出 AI 算力需求持续拉动代工与先进封装景气，台积电的绝对主导地位和 CoWoS 产能瓶颈仍是产业链关键变量。
items.why_en: The figures show AI compute demand still driving foundry and advanced-packaging growth, with TSMC's dominance and the CoWoS bottleneck remaining key industry variables.

items.why_en: If cross-vendor chip interconnection works, it could loosen single-vendor ecosystem lock-in and reshape chip choices in AI infrastructure.

items.summary_zh: AI 原生软件初创公司 Vesta 宣布完成 3000 万美元融资，本轮由 Conversion Capital 领投。该公司主要帮助贷款机构开展抵押贷款发放业务，其方向是让成群的 AI 智能体（agent swarms）参与其中。根据现有信息，融资将用于推动这一模式的落地，但公司未披露具体产品细节与后续商业化计划。
items.summary_en: Vesta, an AI-native software startup that helps lenders originate mortgages, announced a $30 million round led by Conversion Capital.
items.why_zh: 抵押贷款是流程密集、合规要求高的行业，智能体集群若能落地，将成为 AI 切入传统金融运营环节的代表性案例。
items.why_en: Mortgage origination is process-heavy and compliance-bound; agent swarms succeeding here would mark a notable AI entrant into traditional financial operations.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek is reportedly planning to raise more than 80 billion RMB, an unusually large round for a Chinese LLM company. Meanwhile, OpenAI has pledged 28 consecutive days of product or update releases, illustrating intense competition on both capital and product cadence.
items.why_zh: 巨额融资与密集产品发布同日出现，直观反映出中美头部 AI 公司在资本与迭代速度上的正面对抗。
items.why_en: A giant funding round and a marathon release schedule together capture the head-to-head race between leading US and Chinese AI firms.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek新一轮融资或达至少800亿元，腾讯和宁德时代参与 动点科技
items.summary_en: According to Technode, DeepSeek's new funding round could reach at least 80 billion RMB, with Tencent and CATL taking part. If completed, it would rank among the largest AI fundraises in China, spanning both internet and new-energy industrial capital.
items.why_zh: 腾讯与宁德时代等重磅投资方同时入局，说明 DeepSeek 的融资已成为跨产业资本共同押注算力与模型的事件。
items.why_en: The participation of heavyweight investors from both internet and energy sectors shows DeepSeek's round has become a cross-industry bet on compute and models.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek千亿融资落定前夜：钱不是问题，芯片才是 21财经
items.summary_en: As DeepSeek's rumored 100-billion-yuan financing nears completion, a 21 Finance article argues the real bottleneck is chips, not money. Compute and chip access remain the key constraint.
items.why_zh: 它揭示中国 AI 公司即便资金充裕，仍受制于算力与芯片供给。
items.why_en: It highlights that even well-funded Chinese AI firms remain constrained by compute and chip supplies.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek千亿融资落定前夜：钱不是问题，芯片才是 finance.sina.com.cn
items.summary_en: A Sina Finance report examines the run-up to DeepSeek's reported near-100-billion-yuan funding round, arguing that money is not the constraint — chips are. The piece frames compute and chip supply as the key variable for the company's next stage of growth.
items.why_zh: 它点出了当前大模型竞赛的真实瓶颈：资金可以迅速到位，但高端算力供给才是决定胜负的稀缺资源。
items.why_en: It highlights the real bottleneck in the LLM race: capital can be raised quickly, but access to high-end compute is the scarce, decisive resource.
